All API requests must include a valid Bearer token in the

2. Core Endpoints
###
POST /v2/vectors/upsert
Inserts or updates vector embeddings alongside structured JSON metadata payloads. Supports batches of up to 1,000 vectors per request.
###
POST /v2/vectors/query
Executes a nearest-neighbor similarity search combined with optional boolean metadata filters.

## 1. Core System Architecture

CloudNote Pro operates on a multi-tenant cloud architecture separated into three primary layers:

1. **Client Layer:** Cross-platform applications built with Electron (macOS, Windows), React (Web), and Swift/Kotlin (iOS, Android).
2. **API Gateway & Sync Engine:** A real-time Conflict-Free Replicated Data Type (CRDT) synchronization service written in Rust that merges concurrent edits with sub-50ms latency.
3. **Storage Layer:**
- **Metadata & Permissions:** PostgreSQL cluster with row-level security.
- **Document Blobs & Media:** AES-256 encrypted object storage with automated regional replication.
- **Search Index:** Vector and keyword hybrid search index for instant workspace retrieval.

---

# CloudNote Pro: Knowledge Base & Architecture Guide

## Overview
**CloudNote Pro** is a collaborative workspace and document management platform designed for distributed teams. This document serves as a structured knowledge base sample for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic chunking, and instruction-tuning workflows.

---

## 3. Troubleshooting Common Sync Conflicts

### Symptoms
Users editing a document offline may occasionally notice a banner stating: *"Sync Conflict Detected: A copy of your local edits has been saved."*

### Root Cause
While the CRDT engine automatically merges text edits, structural conflicts can occur when one user deletes a parent folder while another offline user adds new documents inside that same folder.

### Resolution Steps
1. Open the **Conflict Resolution Drawer** from the left sidebar.
2. Compare the **Local Version** timestamp against the **Cloud Version** timestamp.
3. Select **Keep Both** to restore the deleted folder structure alongside your offline notes, or **Merge into Active Workspace** to relocate the orphaned notes to your root directory.

---

## 2. Subscription Tiers & Rate Limits

| Feature / Metric | Starter (Free) | Team Plan ($12/user/mo) | Enterprise (Custom) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Max Workspace Members** | 3 | 100 | Unlimited |
| **Storage Quota** | 5 GB total | 50 GB per user | Unlimited |
| **Version History** | 7 days | 90 days | Unlimited + Audit Logs |
| **REST API Rate Limit** | 60 req/min | 1,000 req/min | 10,000 req/min |
| **SSO / SAML 2.0** | Not included | Add-on ($3/user/mo) | Included |

---

## 4. Security & Compliance Standards

- **Encryption in Transit:** All client-server communication enforces TLS 1.3 with strict certificate pinning on mobile clients.
- **Encryption at Rest:** Customer documents are encrypted using AES-256-GCM with customer-managed keys (CMK) available on Enterprise plans.
- **Compliance Certifications:** SOC 2 Type II audited annually, GDPR compliant, and HIPAA Business Associate Agreements (BAA) available upon request.

Category: Technical Bug / Sync Issue
Sentiment: Frustrated
Customer Query:
The desktop app on macOS keeps freezing every time I try to export a notebook larger than 50 pages to PDF. I've restarted my computer twice and reinstalled the app, and it still crashes at 80% progress. I have a client presentation tomorrow morning and need this fixed urgently.
Agent Response:
I completely understand how urgent this is ahead of your presentation. There is a known memory allocation bug in v4.2.1 when rendering high-resolution embedded tables during PDF export. As an immediate workaround, please log into the web app at app.cloudnote.example and export the notebook from there, as the web renderer handles large files on our cloud servers. Our engineering team is releasing patch v4.2.2 later today.
Resolution Status: Escalated / Workaround Provided

--- RECORD 005 ---
Ticket ID: TKT-88438
Category: API & Developer Support
Sentiment: Neutral
Customer Query:
We are hitting a 429 Too Many Requests error when running our nightly backup script via the REST API. Our plan says we get 1,000 requests per minute, and our script only sends about 300. Why is it getting throttled?
Agent Response:
Great question. While the workspace limit is 1,000 requests per minute across all endpoints, the `/v2/notes/export` endpoint has a dedicated burst limit of 60 requests per minute due to payload size. Implementing an exponential backoff or batching up to 25 note IDs per request will keep you well within the burst threshold.
Resolution Status: Resolved
